checklist.name: Freedom Broker Chat QA
checklist.description: Operator performance in one client conversation (RU / KZ / EN).

version.clarifications:
NO vs N/A: NO = the action was required but was skipped or done wrong. N/A = the criterion does not apply under its stated condition.
Consultation (C4) vs Dialogue management (C6): C4 measures whether the request was solved correctly and completely. C6 measures how clearly and consistently the operator communicated. Example: a clear answer to only one of two important questions can score high on C6 and partial on C4.
Out of scope: the 3-minute first-response threshold, tags, and attachments are not part of the evaluation.

criteria.title: Contact establishment
criteria.rule_text: YES = in the first reply, the operator greeted the client in the client's language AND introduced themselves.

criteria.title: Needs identification
criteria.na_condition: The client gave enough information from the start.
criteria.rule_text: YES = the operator used details already known AND clarified missing details before answering.

criteria.title: Identity verification
criteria.na_condition: The request did not require verification (e.g., a general question about tariffs).
criteria.rule_text: YES = identity verification was confirmed before disclosing data or performing a protected action. NO = verification was required but is not confirmed in the chat.

criteria.title: Correct and complete consultation

scale_descriptions.20: All essential questions are resolved, or a correct next step is given.
scale_descriptions.15: The main question is resolved, but a secondary detail is missed.
scale_descriptions.10: Part of the request is resolved, but an essential question remains open.
scale_descriptions.5: Only a general hint is given, and the client still doesn't know how to proceed.
scale_descriptions.0: There is no substantive answer, or the key recommendation is wrong.

criteria.na_condition: The chat ended before the client stated a request.
criteria.rule_text: Rate the answer or the next step using the scale.

criteria.title: Empathy and client focus
criteria.rule_text: YES = the operator was polite AND, if the client expressed dissatisfaction or described an inconvenience, responded to that specific problem.

criteria.title: Dialogue management, speed, literacy

scale_descriptions.10: Replies are clear and coherent. If there was an explicit wait, the operator warned the client.
scale_descriptions.7: There is one noticeable lapse, but the client can understand and continue.
scale_descriptions.4: The client has to re-ask because of wording or the order of replies.
scale_descriptions.0: Incoherent or contradictory replies make the dialogue impossible to follow.

criteria.rule_text: Rate clarity, order of replies, and warnings about waits using the scale.

criteria.title: Closing
criteria.na_condition: The chat broke off before the operator could close it.
criteria.rule_text: YES = the operator summarized OR offered further help, AND said goodbye.

criteria.title: Critical violations
criteria.rule_text: YES = at least one of these occurred: (a) insulting the client; (b) offering a paid service bypassing the company; (c) disclosing confidential information. NO = none of them occurred. Paid service bypassing the company (b): flag it if the operator suggests the client transfer money to them personally for investing, OR asks for the client's personal number to give a private paid consultation. The offer alone is enough; client agreement or an actual transfer is not required. If YES, name the violation type in the explanation.
